chunks: When you wish to visit their two graves, then perform ghusl (ritual bath), cleanse yourself, and wear your two pure garments. If you reach their two graves, then do so; otherwise, gesture from near the gate that opens onto the street, if Allah wills, and say: Peace be upon you both, O the two friends of Allah; peace be upon you both, O the two proofs of Allah; peace be upon you both, O the two lights of Allah in the darknesses of the earth.

I have come to you both knowing your right, showing enmity to your enemies, showing loyalty to your friends, believing in what you both believed, disbelieving in what you both disbelieved, affirming what you both affirmed, and invalidating what you both invalidated. I ask Allah, my Lord and your Lord, to make my portion from visiting you both the blessings upon Muhammad and his family, and to grant me your companionship in the gardens along with your righteous forefathers. I ask Him to free my neck from the Fire, to grant me your intercession and your companionship, not to separate between me and you both, not to strip me of your love and the love of your righteous forefathers, not to make this the last of my covenant in visiting you both, and to make my gathering with you both in Paradise by His mercy. O Allah, grant me love for them both and cause me to die upon their creed.

O Allah, curse those who wrongfully took the right of the family of Muhammad and take vengeance upon them. O Allah, curse the first of them and the last of them, and multiply upon them the painful punishment, and cause them, their followers, their lovers, and their partisans to reach the lowest depth of Hell.
Indeed, You are powerful over all things.
O Allah, hasten the relief of Your wali and the son of Your wali, and make our relief together with his, O most merciful of the merciful.

And strive in supplication for yourself and for your parents, and pray near them for every visitation two rak'ahs, two rak'ahs. If you do not reach them, then enter one of the mosques and pray for the visitation of each Imam two rak'ahs, and supplicate to Allah with whatever you wish. Indeed, Allah is near, responsive.

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication and etiquette for visiting the graves of the two Imams in Samarra?
ai.summary: This text teaches the etiquette and supplication for visiting the graves of the two Imams in Samarra, beginning with ghusl (ritual bath), cleanliness, and respectful address. It combines declaration of wilayah, disavowal of the enemies of Ahl al-Bayt, requests for shafa'ah, salvation from the Fire, companionship in Paradise, and prescribed prayer and du'a during the visitation.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.3211 - When you wish to visit their graves, perform ghusl (ritual purification), clean yourself, and wear two clean garments. If you can reach their graves, then do so. Otherwise, gesture towards them from the gate facing the street, if Allah (swt) wills, and say:
"Peace be upon you both, O the allies of Allah (swt).
Peace be upon you both, O the proofs of Allah (swt).
Peace be upon you both, O the lights of Allah (swt) in the darkness of the earth.

I have come to you acknowledging your rights, opposing your enemies, aligning with your allies, believing in what you believed in, disbelieving in what you disbelieved in, affirming what you affirmed, and rejecting what you rejected.
I ask Allah (swt), my Lord (azj) and your Lord (azj), to make my share of visiting you both to be prayers upon Muhammad and his family, and to grant me your companionship in Paradise alongside your righteous ancestors.
I ask Him to free me from Hellfire, to bless me with your intercession and your companionship, never to separate me from you, and not to deprive me of love for you and your righteous forefathers.
I ask Him not to make this my last visit to you and to make my gathering with you in Paradise through His mercy.
O Allah (swt), grant me their love and let me die upon their creed.

O Allah (swt), curse the oppressors who wronged the family of Muhammad, avenge them.
O Allah (swt), curse the first and the last of them, and double upon them the severe punishment.
Deliver them, their followers, their supporters, and their adherents to the lowest pit of Hell.
Indeed, You are capable of all things.
O Allah (swt), hasten the deliverance of Your wali and the son of Your wali, and make our relief coincide with his. O Most Merciful of the merciful."

Then, engage yourself in supplication for yourself, your parents, and others. Pray two units of prayer (rak'ahs) for each visit. If you cannot reach their graves, enter a mosque, pray two rak'ahs for each Imam’s visitation, and supplicate to Allah (swt) for whatever you desire. Surely, Allah (swt) is near and responsive.
